question_text: Explain how encrypting a confidential message protects it while it travels over an untrusted network.
adaptation_rationale: Original application rewritten to be self-contained; assessed reasoning retained within cited 2027 scope.
solution: The plain text is transformed into ciphertext using an encryption algorithm/key.; A party intercepting traffic cannot readily read the content without the appropriate key.; The intended recipient can decrypt it with the appropriate key, preserving confidentiality.
